info.title: GraphRAG Educational API
info.description: AIxLearning integration contract, exported 2026-10-20 from chore/repo-reorg (staging f609d65 + the security fixes of the same day). Only the /api routes. Guide: docs/api/Chatbot_API_Guide.md. Authentication: HTTP Basic with the instance's client name and password, plus X-End-User-Id.

post.description:
Get educational context from GraphRAG knowledge graph (retrieval-only mode of the Agentic GraphRAG system).

This endpoint:
1. Translates the query (if needed)
2. Generates a Cypher query
3. Retrieves relevant nodes from Neo4j
4. Builds structured educational context
5. Returns everything in a format ready for prompt injection

DEV team can use the returned data directly in their Jinja2 templates.

**Inputs:**
- `query`, `domain`, `language` — frozen base contract (unchanged for the DEV team).
- `educational_profile` *(optional, CORE 1 #2.5)* — per-request class / classroom context
  (BES, grade level, classroom resources). Backward compatible: omit it and the response
  preserves the original generic behavior. When supplied, downstream prompt enrichment
  and methodology ranking will specialize against the profile.

*Tip:* in the Swagger UI **Try it out** panel, use the **Examples** dropdown to switch
between the *Minimal* (legacy) and *Rich* (with `educational_profile`) call shapes.

*Note:* Agent mode (LangGraph multi-agent lesson planning) is exposed by separate
endpoints (`POST /api/v1/agent/run` for sync JSON and `POST /api/v1/agent/stream`
for SSE; CORE 2 #7) and is not available here. Both use the same
`educational_profile` shape as the Rich example below.

post.summary: Run the agent and return the final lesson plan (sync JSON)
post.description: Drives the full **Planner → Retriever → Writer → Critic** pipeline and returns a single JSON response with the final Markdown lesson plan plus planner / retriever / critic explainability. Typical run: 60–120 seconds. For incremental UI updates use ``POST /api/v1/agent/stream`` instead.

minimal.description: Smallest valid call. Omitting ``educational_profile`` makes the agent fall back to its generic prompts — fine for a quick smoke test from /docs but the lesson plan won't specialize against a specific class.

rich.description: Recommended shape for production calls. Includes every optional EducationalProfile field — class title, BES, class features, student attributes, classroom resources, time budget, subject area, specific topic — so the planner / writer can specialize prompts against the real class. ``teacher_provided_context`` may carry up to ~48k chars of extra material extracted from teacher uploads (PDF/TXT/MD).

get.summary: Resources on the lesson's subject, found live
get.description: Papers, Wikipedia and videos on the lesson's subject, as the WebUI's right panel shows them after a lesson. Best effort: empty when nothing is found or the live search is off. The curated resources of the Knowledge Graph are in the lesson turn's ``retriever.media``.

get.summary: Download the session's lesson: md, txt, pdf, docx or outline
get.description: The same files as the WebUI's download buttons: citations resolved to the documents' names, the AI notice in every format. ``outline`` is the timed outline as plain text.

post.summary: Let the session's turns search these documents
Send a message and wait for the turn's result
post.description: Waits until the turn ends: a few seconds for an answer, about a minute for a lesson. For progress as it happens use ``/turns/stream``.

post.summary: Send a message and follow the turn as Server-Sent Events
post.description: Each ``data:`` frame is JSON. Phase events carry ``kind`` and ``data``: planner, retriever, writer_pending, writer, then either critic_pending and critic (judge off) or judge_pending and judge (judge on, AIX_JUDGE_ENABLED: the targeted review, typically 5-15 s after the text is written; ``data`` is the ``JudgeInfo`` of the result); for a fast answer light_pending and light_done. While the text is written, ``kind: text`` frames carry the next piece (``text``) and the ``draft`` it belongs to; ``kind: draft_end`` closes a draft, and a higher ``draft`` means the lesson is being written again (a Critic revision, the attached documents left unused, a split of the class that does not add up): start the text over. The text is a preview: the last frame is ``kind: result``, the body ``/turns`` returns under ``result``, whose ``markdown`` replaces it -- with the judge on, it is the corrected lesson. A refusal or a failure is a frame ``kind: error`` with ``code`` and ``message``.

AgentRunMeta.title: AgentRunMeta
AgentRunMeta.description: Run-summary metadata returned alongside the final lesson plan.

query.title: Query
query.description: Teacher query in natural language (Italian). Same shape the webui chat input accepts, e.g. 'Crea una lezione di 45 minuti sulla fotosintesi adattata a una classe con 2 studenti DSA'.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Knowledge graph domain to retrieve from. 'neuro' is the neuroscience-of-learning KG; 'udl' is the Universal Design for Learning KG.

language.title: Language
language.description: Output language for the lesson plan and agent reasoning.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The conversation's identity, not a log tag. It becomes LangGraph's ``thread_id``: send the same value again and the run continues that conversation, with its checkpointed history and possibly its reused retrieval corpus. **Two callers that send the same value share a conversation**, so an integrator must scope it per end user — a counter, or a key that is not guessable from outside. When omitted, a UUID4 is generated and the run is a fresh conversation. It is also the correlation id in the logs (CORE 2 #11).

educational_profile.description: CORE 1 #2.5 — per-request class/classroom context. Same Pydantic model the webui /webui/lesson/new form serialises. When omitted, the agent falls back to generic prompts.

teacher_provided_context.title: Teacher Provided Context
teacher_provided_context.description: CORE 2 #6.6 P3 — joined plain text from teacher-uploaded files (PDF / TXT / Markdown) that the Writer should treat as additional context. Truncated to 48k chars to fit the Writer prompt budget. NOT ingested into the Knowledge Graph.

max_revisions.title: Max Revisions
max_revisions.description: Cap on critic revision loops. ``None`` defers to the agent pipeline default (AIX_MAX_REVISIONS env var, default 1). Setting 0 disables critic revisions for fast smoke testing.

AgentRunRequest.title: AgentRunRequest
AgentRunRequest.description:
Input to either ``POST /api/v1/agent/run`` (sync JSON) or
``POST /api/v1/agent/stream`` (SSE-encoded JSON events).

**Unknown fields are kept and logged, not rejected — for now.** A field the
caller misspells (``languag`` for ``language``) is silently dropped under
Pydantic's default, so the lesson comes back in the wrong language and
nothing anywhere says why. ``extra="forbid"`` would turn that into an
immediate 422, which is the behaviour this API should end up with.

It is not on yet because we do not know what the integrating worker
actually sends: one undeclared field in its payload — a trace id, a client
version, a leftover — and every call it makes starts failing, on code we do
not control. So the route logs the *names* of unknown fields on each
request (never the values: an unknown field may carry a teacher's data),
and once the logs show nobody is sending any, this becomes
``extra="forbid"`` and the guesswork ends (2026-09-22).

Mandatory fields are ``query`` + ``domain``. Everything else has sensible
defaults so the smallest valid call from /docs is just::

    {"query": "Crea una lezione su attenzione", "domain": "neuro"}

A richer call attaches an Educational Profile so the planner / writer
can specialise prompts to grade level, BES, classroom resources, etc.

example.query: Crea una lezione di 45 minuti sulla fotosintesi clorofilliana adattata a una classe con 2 studenti DSA
example.teacher_provided_context: Estratto dal manuale (opzionale): 'La fotosintesi è il processo con cui le piante convertono energia luminosa in energia chimica…'

lesson_plan_md.title: Lesson Plan Md
lesson_plan_md.description: Final lesson plan as Markdown. Empty string indicates the agent finished without producing output (rare).

planner.description: Planner-stage explainability. Absent only on early errors that bailed before the planner ran.

retriever.description: Retriever-stage explainability. Absent only on early errors that bailed before the retriever ran.

critic.description: The critic's last judgement on the lesson. Null when the judge is on (AIX_JUDGE_ENABLED): the Critic is then not in the chain.

judge.description: The targeted review, when the judge is on. Null when it is off.

AgentRunResponse.title: AgentRunResponse
AgentRunResponse.description:
Final result of ``POST /api/v1/agent/run`` (sync).

Holds the full lesson plan plus the explainability fields the webui
surfaces in its planner / retriever / critic cards. Consumers that only
need the lesson plan can read ``lesson_plan_md`` and ignore the rest.

passages.title: Passages
passages.description: Passages of the user's documents the answer was given.

forniture_mobility.description: Whether furniture can be moved / rearranged. UNKNOWN or omitted: not said.

has_lim.title: Has Lim

has_wifi.title: Has Wifi

pc_station.title: Pc Station
pc_station.description: Has PC workstations. true/false, or YES/NO/UNKNOWN.

own_device.description: Student personal-device policy (BYOD). UNKNOWN or omitted: not said.

environment_type.description: Where the lesson happens: LOCAL (in presence), REMOTE, HYBRID.

participation_type.description: For REMOTE or HYBRID: SYNC (live), ASYNC (recorded), MIXED.

Nodes capped at 20, edges at 30 to keep rendering performant.

Critic-agent per-criterion scores. Shape matches the internal critic
output and is left intentionally permissive — the critic prompt is the

DisabilityType.title: DisabilityType
DisabilityType.description:
BES (Bisogni Educativi Speciali) types matching `party.models.StudentDisabilities`.

The platform's current eight, then four it no longer offers (still accepted:
lessons and saved profiles carry them).

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Rich domain system prompt (RUOLO, TAG-CLOUD, PRINCIPI, META-REGOLE)

response_template.title: Response Template
response_template.description: Domain-specific response structure (e.g., I Do/We Do/You Do lesson schema)

kg_context_formatted.title: Kg Context Formatted
kg_context_formatted.description: KG data formatted in domain-specific structure, ready for prompt injection

DomainPromptContext.title: DomainPromptContext
DomainPromptContext.description:
Domain-specific prompt context for production integration

Provides the DEV team with everything needed to align their
production prompt with GraphRAG domain expertise.

This is designed to be scalable: each domain (neuro, udl, etc.)
provides its own system_prompt and response_template through the
domain config system.

students_number.title: Students Number
students_number.description: Number of students in the group. Omitted, or 0, when unknown: the prompt then says nothing about class size.

disabilities.title: Disabilities
disabilities.description: Special Educational Needs (BES) present in the class.

time_available_minutes.title: Time Available Minutes
time_available_minutes.description: Available time for the activity in minutes.

pedagogical_intent.title: Pedagogical Intent
pedagogical_intent.description: Teacher's pedagogical intent for this lesson. Stored as '{code}: {optional_detail}' (e.g. 'misconception: practice alone doesn't increase WM capacity'). Code alone is valid when no detail is provided.

EducationalProfile.title: EducationalProfile
EducationalProfile.description:
Complete educational context combining group and environment.

This is the main model that gets attached to API requests to provide
rich, personalized educational context. Every field is optional —
a missing profile must fall back to current generic behavior
(backward-compat acceptance criterion of CORE 1 #2.5).

retrieval_phases.title: Retrieval Phases
retrieval_phases.description: Timing and node count per retrieval phase: graph_traversal, semantic_search, fusion_ranking

graph_coverage.title: Graph Coverage
graph_coverage.description: Human-readable Italian sentence summarising graph coverage

ExplainabilitySummary.title: ExplainabilitySummary
ExplainabilitySummary.description:
Response-level explainability data.

Frontend use:
- label_distribution → render colored concept tag chips
- graph_coverage → display as summary sentence in reliability panel
- retrieval_phases → show retrieval breakdown (graph vs semantic)

FornitureMobility.title: FornitureMobility
FornitureMobility.description:
Furniture mobility matching `classroom.models.Classroom.forniture_mobility`.

Field name preserved (`Forniture` with the typo) to keep 1:1 mapping with
the AixLearning native model field. Do not rename without coordinating
with the FEM platform team.

db_revision.description: Current Alembic revision of the WebUI database

after.title: After
after.description: The text as it is now in the lesson (up to 160 chars).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: «sostituzione»: the sentence replaced; «revisione»: the activity around it rewritten (``before``/``after`` then cover the whole block, truncated).

teacher_material.title: Teacher Material
teacher_material.description: The corrected sentence was taken from the user's attached documents, which the judge does not read: show it as to be checked against them.

JudgeCorrection.title: JudgeCorrection
JudgeCorrection.description: One correction the judge made in the lesson.

revised.title: Revised
revised.description: Corrected by rewriting the activity around it.

reverted.title: Reverted
reverted.description: Corrections judged wrong on verification and put back.

fixed.title: Fixed
fixed.description: The corrections now in the lesson.

points.title: Points
points.description: What could not be corrected: to check by hand.

notes_blocking.title: Notes Blocking
notes_blocking.description: Of the points, the blocking ones.

error.title: Error
error.description: Set when the review failed: the lesson is then the uncorrected one.

JudgeInfo.title: JudgeInfo
JudgeInfo.description:
The targeted review (AIX_JUDGE_ENABLED): the WebUI's «Revisione mirata» card.

Runs after the Writer, in place of the Critic: it reads the whole lesson,
corrects in the text only what is wrong, and checks every correction. The
lesson the API returns is already the corrected one.

direct_hits.title: Direct Hits
direct_hits.description: Nodes found by direct Cypher query (hop_distance=0)

structural_neighbors.title: Structural Neighbors
structural_neighbors.description: Nodes found by graph neighbor expansion (hop_distance=1)

label_distribution.title: Label Distribution
label_distribution.description: Count of nodes per Neo4j label — use this to render concept tags in the UI

KGStats.title: KGStats
KGStats.description: Aggregate statistics about the knowledge graph retrieval

level.title: Level
level.description: 2 for a ## section, 3 for a ### part of it.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: The minutes the section declares, if any.

timed_outline.title: Timed Outline
timed_outline.description: The timed sections without double counting: the outline export.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: What the reader noticed, e.g. minutes that do not add up.

LessonStructure.title: LessonStructure
LessonStructure.description: The lesson as sections and minutes, read from its Markdown (the export model).

status.title: Status
status.description: processing: being read and indexed · ready: searchable · failed: never searchable (see error_code)

MediaCounts.title: MediaCounts
MediaCounts.description: Aggregated counts of curated media for the right sidebar / API summary.

hop_distance.title: Hop Distance
hop_distance.description: Graph distance from query: 0=direct match, 1=1-hop neighbor, 2=2-hop/semantic

graph_path.description: The graph path that led to this node (only present when hop_distance >= 1)

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Technical English sentence explaining the retrieval

MethodologyExplainability.title: MethodologyExplainability
MethodologyExplainability.description:
Provenance data for a single methodology — explains HOW and WHY it was retrieved.

Frontend can use this to render source badges, graph path arrows, and score tooltips.

explainability_name.title: Explainability Name
explainability_name.description: Italian UI label for the source type (e.g. 'Raccomandazione diretta dal Knowledge Graph')

explainability_phrase.title: Explainability Phrase
explainability_phrase.description: Italian human-readable sentence explaining how this methodology was retrieved — render directly as a badge or tooltip

explainability.description: Full provenance data for advanced UI rendering

kg_data_available.title: Kg Data Available
kg_data_available.description: Whether the Knowledge Graph contained relevant data for this query. When false, kg_context_formatted contains guidance for the LLM to use system_prompt principles instead. DEV team can optionally use this flag to skip GraphRAG calls on follow-up messages.

scope_variant.title: Scope Variant
scope_variant.description: success · warning · danger: how the card colours the scope.

subject_concepts.title: Subject Concepts
subject_concepts.description: The subject the lesson is about (searched outside the graph when out of scope).

PlannerInfo.title: PlannerInfo
PlannerInfo.description: What the planner understood: the WebUI's planner card.

RawNode.title: RawNode
RawNode.description: Raw node data from knowledge graph

nodes_found.title: Nodes Found
nodes_found.description: Number of nodes found in this phase

RetrievalPhase.title: RetrievalPhase
RetrievalPhase.description: Stats for a single retrieval phase

media.title: Media

kg_unreachable.title: Kg Unreachable
kg_unreachable.description: The Knowledge Graph did not answer: the lesson was written without it. Not the same as an out-of-scope question.

coverage_tier.title: Coverage Tier

reused.title: Reused

reuse_reason.title: Reuse Reason

RetrieverInfo.title: RetrieverInfo
RetrieverInfo.description: What the search found: the WebUI's retriever card.

quote.title: Quote

fix.title: Fix

ReviewNote.title: ReviewNote

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Knowledge Graph domain: neuro (neuroscience) or udl.

educational_profile.description: The class and classroom, as in the WebUI's profile form. Set ``pedagogical_intent`` here: the API does not ask for it with a card.

material_ids.title: Material Ids
material_ids.description: Documents from ``/api/v1/materials`` this session's turns may search.

SessionMedia.title: SessionMedia

status.title: Status

status.title: Status
status.description: draft (no turn yet) · running · complete · error

message.title: Message

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto: as the WebUI -- the first turn writes a lesson, later turns answer in a few seconds, and a request for a new lesson comes back as ``handoff``. answer: answer here, never hand off (needs a lesson). lesson: the whole chain, a new version of the lesson.

search_graph.description: On a follow-up that rewrites the lesson: false reuses what the Knowledge Graph already found, true searches again. Omitted: the agent decides.

material_ids.title: Material Ids

cited_documents.title: Cited Documents

retriever.description: For a lesson: the search card.

critic.description: For a lesson: the critic card. Null when the judge is on (the Critic is then not in the chain).
